name: WebTUI (terminal look)
description: Terminal/TUI rendering of the tailor vocabulary: monospace character grid, ch/lh rhythm, square corners, 2px frames, inverse-video selection, bracket checkboxes, braille spinner. WebTUI's attribute rules translated onto t-* selectors (nothing imported).
notes: Translation, not a vendoring: the relevant @webtui/css 0.1.10 rules (box utility, button, badge, input, checkbox/radio/switch, spinner, progress, dialog, table) were rewritten on t-* selectors with --t-* colours; WebTUI's --background0..3/--foreground0..2/--box-border-color are bridged to --t-* for projects that add WebTUI markup alongside. Known WebTUI gotchas deliberately not carried over: body word-break:break-all, dialog position:absolute, 3lh default buttons. Badge/button text on a tone fill uses --t-canvas (WebTUI's background0 convention), so it depends on the palette's tone-vs-canvas contrast.
